title: Diagnostic JSON pass for editorial slop
description:
**Phase 2 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a diagnose-only pass that returns structured findings, so I can steer which problems to skip, delete, or send to an LLM for rewrite options.

## Done when

- A first pass returns **structured JSON only** (no prose rewrite): document_intent, audience, generic_passages, unsupported_claims, repetition_groups, voice_observations, required_facts.
- Detects at least: vague claims, empty lead-ins, uniform cadence, list-shaped prose, unsupported certainty, redundancy, voice mismatch vs style profile.
- Schema is automation-friendly and versioned.
- Each finding has a stable id so a human can record skip / rewrite / delete / keep / add without a whole-document rewrite.

## Out of scope

Rewriting the draft in this pass. Generating rewrite options (that is Phase 3, and only for findings a human marked rewrite).

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Diagnostic JSON pass for editorial slop
  As a publication operator
  I want structured diagnosis of a draft against a style profile
  So I can steer which findings to act on without a machine rewriting the article in this pass

  Scenario: Diagnose a draft without rewriting it
    Given a draft and a loadable style profile
    When the diagnostic pass runs
    Then it returns versioned JSON with document_intent, audience, generic_passages, unsupported_claims, repetition_groups, voice_observations, and required_facts
    And each finding has a stable id
    And the findings cover vague claims, empty lead-ins, uniform cadence, list-shaped prose, unsupported certainty, redundancy, and voice mismatch
    And the result does not include rewritten prose

  Scenario: Findings are a steering queue
    Given diagnostic JSON from a completed diagnose pass
    When an operator records skip, rewrite, delete, or keep against a finding id
    Then later option generation can address only the findings marked rewrite
```
